title: Resolve diagnostic E-104
summary: Diagnose version 1.5 error E-104, which indicates that an Ethernet address conflicts with another host.

sections.title: Meaning
paragraphs: In version 1.5, E-104 reports a duplicate IPv4 address. Version 2.0 reassigns this identifier to certificate validity, so always filter by version.

warning.condition: A procedure for another software version is followed.
warning.consequence: Troubleshooting can change unrelated certificate settings without resolving the address conflict.
warning.avoidance: Confirm the installed version and keep the version filter active.

sections.title: Resolution
paragraphs: Use the switch address table and an ARP inspection from an isolated workstation to locate the conflicting host.
steps: Disconnect the controller from the production segment.
Confirm its configured static address and subnet.
Locate the duplicate MAC address in the switch or DHCP records.
Assign a unique address under the site's addressing plan.
Reconnect and verify that E-104 does not recur.
